text:
Maria R: Quick sync — thinking about 'nonuniform' precision profiles: allow per-layer / per-tensor precision mappings (e.g., FP8 for attention, INT8 for MLP, 4-bit for some embeddings). Need to align runtime contract, ops rollout, and telemetry.
Ken T: Do we mean runtime will pick per-request mapping, or these are baked per-model-version?
Maria R: Prefer map baked into a model profile but runtime can override with strict guardrails. intent: stable default + fallback hints.
Ashok P: Fwiw, per-request variability is expensive for caching/KV reuse. If runtime toggles precision per request we lose most cache hit benefits.
Sara L: Ops question: how do we canary these without exploding cost? want clear SLOs and a degradation budget.
Liam W: config idea (proto-ish):
```
precision_profile: {
  model_id: "m-44B",
  tiers: [
    {scope: "attn", precision: "fp8"},
    {scope: "mlp", precision: "int8"},
    {scope: "emb", precision: "4bit", guard: "degrade_score<0.02"}
  ]
}
```
Maria R: Nice. Need to add metadata for stability score and sample eval set reference. also per-customer overrides?
Ken T: Interface question: how does client request a fallback policy? header like `X-Precision-Mode: prefer_profile|force|fallback`?
Ashok P: +1 header, but runtime must expose why it picked fallback (telemetry id, reason). add a short event id to trace.
Sara L: Canary plan proposal: start 0.5% traffic on dedicated slot, measure latency p50/p95, and quality via holdout prompts (BLEU/deg-score). escalate if deg > 1.5% or latency up 10%.
Liam W: Ops cost optimization: schedule aggressive quant lanes offpeak for background warmup and use KV priming to avoid cold latency.
Maria R: Telemetry fields we need: profile_id, chosen_precision_map, fallback_reason, degradation_score, eval_snapshot_id, KV_cache_hit. also anomaly tag when mismatched tokenwise quality.
Ken T: Who owns the profile lifecycle? Research creates profile, eng-runtime validates, ops owns rollout. Need a small handoff checklist.
Ashok P: Checklist items: compatibility test (no NaNs), determinism smoke, sample-outputs regression < threshold, perf bench on target infra.
Sara L: Add an ops step: run 24h soak at 5% traffic and verify traceroute/trace ids for incident correlation.
Liam W: Minor: add a lint/validator in CI that flags unsafe combos (e.g., fp8 on unsupported kernel).
dev-bot: CI: precision-profile-lint passed for branch nonuniform-profiles (jobs: lint, unit, integration). :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: deployment-schedule posted for canary window: 2026-04-05 02:00-06:00 UTC.
Maria R: Next actions: Ashok to draft runtime API changes, Liam to sketch profile proto + CI linter, Sara to write ops canary runbook, Ken to draft handoff checklist. ping when done. :pray:
